title: Call graph lookup
description: Look up binary-ground-truth caller/callee edges and symbolized data-reference edges generated from build/GALE01/asm, joined to report.json function metadata.
status_message: Live runner v2: call edges and data-reference edges are generated locally from build/GALE01/asm by toolpacks/gamecube-decomp/research/callgraph/runners/extract_call_graph.py.
limitations: Call edges include symbolic bl instructions only; indirect calls are not resolved.
Data-reference edges include symbolized @ha, @h, @l, @sda21, and @sda2 relocations on non-branch instructions; rerun after rebuilding asm/report outputs.

usage.agent_guidance: Use binary-ground-truth call and data-reference edges to orient a function before editing.
